title: Cowboys-Giants SNF Opener Draws 25.7M Viewers, Strongest Season Premiere Since 2015
dek: The Dallas Cowboys-New York Giants Sunday Night Football season opener averaged 25.7 million viewers on NBC and Peacock, the most-watched SNF season-opener broadcast since 2015. The game peaked at 29.0 million viewers in the second quarter; the Giants won 28-20.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: Cowboys-Giants SNF opener averaged 25.7M viewers on NBC/Peacock, topping all SNF season openers since 2015, a 4% increase over last year's Bills-Ravens opener.
bottom_line: The SNF opening drew the strongest regular-season-opener viewership since 2015 despite criticism of the matchup's repetition, but softer numbers for the competing Wednesday kickoff suggest Thursday and Friday openings may be diluting the league's traditional launch audience.
body:
The Dallas Cowboys-New York Giants matchup on Sunday Night Football averaged 25.7 million viewers across NBC and Peacock, according to Nielsen Big Data and internal metrics, making it the most-watched SNF season-opener broadcast since 2015. The Giants won 28-20. Viewership peaked at 29.0 million on NBC and Peacock during the second quarter (9-9:15 p.m. ET).
The 25.7 million average represents a 4 percent increase from last season's SNF season-opener, which featured the Buffalo Bills and Baltimore Ravens. It was also the first time two NBC Sports NFL opening-weekend broadcasts both averaged 25 million-plus viewers since 2015, when the Pittsburgh Steelers-New England Patriots Thursday opener and the Giants-Cowboys Sunday night game drew comparable audiences, both decided by one score.
The strong result comes despite media criticism of repetitive Cowboys-Giants primetime scheduling. ESPN's Stanford Steve stated he was "so tired" of watching the pair in primetime, reflecting broader skepticism about the matchup's frequency in the league's top billing. Yet the audience data suggests the appetite for marquee NFL openers remains strong enough to overcome such fatigue.
Widening distribution across streaming and broadcast platforms offered more avenues for viewers than in previous years. Peacock's inclusion as a co-platform with NBC likely contributed to the total reach.
The opening week showed mixed viewership patterns elsewhere. Wednesday's NFL Kickoff game, featuring the Seattle Seahawks and New England Patriots on NBC and Peacock, averaged 25.1 million viewers, the lowest season-opening broadcast audience since 2022.
